backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the GenMitra print platform backend, defining data types (ProductInfo, Template, Order, etc.), stable storage maps, and public functions for user profiles, product/template/order management, cart operations, payments, and pincode/address handling with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the frontend codebase was audited and updated to include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' as a permitted origin in message handlers and origin whitelists, with high confidence and mapped to test REQ-25.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key fixes applied to hooks, components, pages, and utilities in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the GenMitra Print Platform SPA, mounting the React app at the `#root` div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app entry point that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (public, layout, and admin), and includes an `OriginHandler` component that manages postMessage communication with allowed origins including the Caffeine preview domain.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the admin panel shell with a responsive sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Products, Templates, Orders, Customers, Settings), user info, and a logout button.
A paginated customer reviews section component displaying star ratings, reviewer details, and review text in a card layout with sort controls and previous/next navigation.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Renders a two-column FAQ section with 8 accordion-style items that toggle open/closed using local state and Plus/X icons.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Displays a grid of featured products (with hardcoded demo fallbacks across categories like prints, frames, magnets, and mugs) fetched via React Query, supporting add-to-cart and navigation to product detail pages.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with link columns for stores, company, support, and policies, plus contact info, social media icons, and a payment icons row.
frontend/src/components/HeroBanner.tsx: Full-width hero section with a background image, headline, tagline, Shop Now/View Catalog buttons, and three stat highlights (customers, rating, delivery speed).
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app shell providing a sticky header with logo, category navigation, cart count badge, auth actions, a promo bar, and a footer wrapping all page content.
frontend/src/components/OffersBanner.tsx: Promotional banner section displaying a discount offer with a background image, coupon code highlight, and a Shop Now button.
frontend/src/components/ProductCategoryG: Renders a responsive grid of five product category cards with images and descriptions, each navigating to the home page filtered by that category on click.
frontend/src/components/ShopFramesBySize: Renders a section with clickable size buttons (4×6" to 20×24") that let users filter frames by size, navigating to the home route on selection.
frontend/src/components/TrustFeatures.ts: Displays a four-column trust-signal section with icons and descriptions for Google rating, nationwide delivery, satisfaction guarantee, and customer support.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Wraps Internet Identity login/logout with React Query-backed user profile, role, and admin status queries, exposing a unified auth state object.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity React context provider and hook that manages AuthClient creation, login flow, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions including products, templates, cart, orders, and user profile CRUD operations via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines the global CSS with Tailwind directives, a purple-based OKLCH design token system (light and dark modes), custom component classes, and utility helpers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying summary stat cards (orders, earnings, users, products) and a recent-orders table with status badges, linking to the full orders list. Data is fetched via useGetDashboardSummary and useGetAllOrders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettingsPa: Admin settings page for managing delivery pincodes, allowing admins to add or remove 6-digit pincodes via forms with toast notifications for success/failure feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/CustomerManagem: Admin page that lists all registered customers in a table with their profile details and order counts, with expandable rows to view individual order history.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin order management page that displays all orders with status filtering, status update controls, and functionality to download custom images and generate/download production files via canvas.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ProductManageme: Admin product management page supporting create, edit, and delete operations for products, including image upload fields for product and template images and size option management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TemplateManagem: Admin template management page for creating, editing, and deleting photo templates, with image upload support for template and preview images and configurable photo slots and DPI settings.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays the shopping cart with item removal, address entry with pincode availability check, payment method selection (COD/Online), and order placement flow across cart/address/payment/success steps.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Full checkout page with address form pre-filled from saved address, multiple payment method options (COD/UPI/CARD/NETBANKING), a mock payment modal for non-COD methods, and order submission with navigation to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/CreateAccountPage.tsx: Account creation form collecting username and optional email, triggering Internet Identity login on submit and navigating to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Canvas-based photo editor allowing users to upload an image, apply template overlays, zoom/drag the image, select a size, and add the customized product to the cart.
frontend/src/pages/ForgotPasswordPage.ts: Forgot password page with an email input that simulates sending a reset link and shows a confirmation state after submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that composes multiple section components (hero, categories, featured products, offers, FAQ, reviews), conditionally hiding most sections when a category filter is active.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login page with an Internet Identity button, redirecting authenticated users to admin or home based on their role. Shows a loading spinner during login and links to account creation and forgot-password routes.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Displays a list of the current user's orders as clickable cards with status badges, loading skeletons, and an empty state with a shop CTA. Uses the useGetMyOrders hook to fetch order data.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a post-checkout confirmation screen with order details (ID, items, total, payment, delivery) fetched via useTrackOrder, plus navigation buttons to track the order or return home.
frontend/src/pages/OrderDetailPage.tsx: Renders a detailed order view including a step-based status tracker, item list with images, and order metadata fetched by orderId using useTrackOrder. Displays skeletons while loading and an error message if the order is not found.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Shows a single product's image, description, size selector, quantity picker, and add-to-cart/customize actions, falling back to a demo product when data is loading or unavailable. Uses useGetProduct and useAddToCart hooks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens (brand, sidebar, chart, etc.), border radii, box shadows, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 13) describing the full-stack online printing platform's architecture, tech stack, known issues, existing features, and deployment targets.
